The image shows green banana fruits with dark brown/black lesions visible on the fruit skin — some at the tips and others on the body of individual fingers. The lesions appear sunken and discrete on the fruit surface.

**Analysis:**
- **Affected part:** Banana fruit (fingers), not leaves or plant structure
- **Visual features:** Dark brown to black, sunken-looking spots on the skin of green banana fingers
- **Location of lesions:** On the surface and tips of the banana fruit

**Ruling out other classes:**
- Cigar End Rot: Would show corrugated, powdery grey ash-like tissue specifically at the blossom/cigar end — not matching the scattered spots seen here
- All leaf-based diseases (Yellow_And_Black_Sigatoka, Cordana_Leaf_Spot, Banana_Bunchy_Top_Virus, Panama_Disease) — the image shows fruit, not leaves
- The lesions match Anthracnose: "black and sunken lesions on banana fruits" — exactly what is visible in this image, with dark, discrete spots on the green fruit surface
